name: Nierakus
backstory: Child of Niekus and Nieragan in Salthos Cruzados; raised alongside walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., having heard about Gorff Ledger Crossing War.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Darnakus and Niemoran now have a child, Niemornak.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dornakus.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Fenserika and Darius now have a child, Darika.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darinak.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Nieragus and Dorakus now have a child, Nieradus.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Birth Of Doraknus their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Birth Of Doraknus as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: minds the crossing's morning traffic, checks papers out of habit more than suspicion, and trades gossip with the regulars before they're waved on
